info.name: Admin APIs
info.description: Admin portal API endpoints for managing users and viewing system data. All endpoints require admin privileges (roleId = 17).

request.description: Login with admin credentials (roleId = 17). Token will have isAdmin: true flag.

query.description: Search by name, email, or phone

request.description: Search and filter users with advanced options.

query.description: User ID (optional if present in path)

request.description: Get detailed information about a specific user including role, organizations, and login history.
Update a user's status within a specific organisation (UserOrganisations table). Org id is in the URL path only; body carries status. Valid options: Active, Disabled, Invited, Expired.
Get login history for a specific user including timestamp and browser agent.
Admin-assisted resend invitation email. Only works for users with status Invited. Organisation id is in the URL path only.
Admin-assisted password reset for any user. No OTP required. Password must be at least 8 characters.
Search organisations by name with pagination
Get detailed organisation information by ID
Search roles by name with pagination

item.name: Organisation Monitoring
Get Orgs Trials Expiring In X Days

query.description: Number of days to look ahead (default: 7)

request.description: Get organisations with trial subscriptions expiring in X days. Integrates with Stripe to check trial_end dates.
Get organisations with past_due or unpaid subscription status. Shows amount due and period end date.
Get organisations exceeding their subscription seat limit. Shows seat limit, active users, and overage count.
Get organisations grouped by subscription plan type. Without planType parameter, returns summary of all plans. With planType, returns filtered list.

item.description: Monitor organisations subscriptions, trials, and seat limits

item.name: Data Export

query.description: Export format: csv or json (default: csv)

request.description: Export all tasks for a specific organisation. Returns CSV file download by default, or JSON with format=json parameter.

query.description: Export format: csv or json (default: csv)

request.description: Export ALL tasks from ALL organisations (Super Admin only). Returns CSV file download by default, or JSON with format=json parameter.

item.description: Export data endpoints for tasks and other entities

item.name: System & Statistics

request.description: Get all roles in the system.
Get comprehensive usage metrics across all modules: users, storage, documents, leads, tasks, appointments, and notifications. Includes conversion rates and completion rates.

item.description: System information and usage metrics endpoints

request.description: Bulk upload CRM automations as superadmin using a CSV/XLS/XLSX file upload. Organisation is determined from the URL path segment after `/crm/org/`. Only the file field is required in the form body.
Download the CRM automation bulk upload sample CSV for admin/superadmin use.

item.name: CRM

request.description: Get organisation-level CRM feature access flags for Meta, WhatsApp, and Chatbot.
Allow or restrict CRM Meta, WhatsApp, and Chatbot features for a specific organisation.

item.description: Admin CRM endpoints for treatments, lead sources, and alerts

item.name: CRM Leads

request.description: Download the CRM leads bulk upload sample CSV for admin/superadmin use.
Bulk upload CRM leads as superadmin using a CSV/XLS/XLSX file upload. Organisation is taken from the URL path after `/crm/org/`. Only the file field is required in the form body.

item.description: Admin CRM lead bulk upload endpoints

item.name: CRM Scripts Pool
Get Script Pool Item By ID

item.description: Admin CRUD endpoints for global CRM Scripts Pool dictionary items

request.description: Deduct points from a user (Admin only)
Award bonus points to a user (Admin only)
Get all reward point definitions (admin catalogue)
Add new reward point definition
Get reporting on points issued by admin users
Get points totals by practice/organisation

item.name: Task Pool

request.description: View global task pool (Super Admin). Shows all template/predefined tasks that can be assigned to users across all practices.

query.description: Task ID (optional if present in path)

request.description: Get a specific task by ID with full details including category, role, organisation, and creator information. Returns 404 if task not found.

formdata.description: CSV file with columns: title, description, categoryId, roleId, defaultFrequency

request.description: Upload multiple tasks from CSV file. Creates tasks in the task pool WITHOUT user assignment. Requires categoryId to specify the task category.
Download CSV template for bulk task upload. Template does NOT include user column.

item.description: Manage global task pool and bulk task uploads

item.name: Task Checklists

request.description: Get all task checklist items with optional filtering by task ID or search term.

query.description: Checklist item ID (optional if present in path)

request.description: Get a specific checklist item by ID with associated task details.

body.raw:
{
  "taskId": 123,
  "question": "Check fire alarm",
  "category": "Safety",
  "fieldOneTitle": "Comments / Notes",
  "fieldOneValue": "Last checked on 2026-01-15",
  "fieldTwoTitle": null,
  "fieldTwoValue": null,
  "showRadio": true,
  "showTime": false,
  "showDate": false,
  "radioValue": "N/A",
  "timeValue": null,
  "dateValue": null
}

request.description: Create a new checklist item for a task. Required fields: taskId, question.
Update an existing checklist item. Only provided fields will be updated.
Delete a checklist item by ID.

Upload multiple checklist items from CSV file. Automatically creates tasks if they don't exist (as system tasks). Groups checklist items by taskTitle. Use downloadChecklistTemplate to get sample CSV format.
Download CSV template for bulk checklist upload with sample data.

item.description: Manage task checklists with CRUD operations and bulk upload functionality

item.name: Task Categories

request.description: Get all system task categories (parent categories only). System categories have organisationId = NULL and isDeleted = false.

query.description: Category ID (optional if present in path)

request.description: Get a specific task category by ID with its subcategories and parent (if subcategory).

query.description: Parent category ID (optional if present in path)

request.description: Get all subcategories for a specific parent category.
Create a new task category or subcategory. Set parentId to create a subcategory, or null for parent category. Name must be unique at the same level.
Update an existing task category. Only provided fields will be updated. Name must be unique at the same level.
Soft delete a task category (sets isDeleted = true). Cannot delete if category has tasks or subcategories assigned.

item.description: Manage system task categories and subcategories. Only shows categories where organisationId is NULL and isDeleted is false.

item.name: Default Priorities & Statuses

request.description: Get all default priorities. These are the master priorities that all organisations inherit.
Get all default statuses. These are the master statuses that all organisations inherit.
Create a new default priority. This will be available for all organisations to use.
Update a default priority by id (URL). Changes cascade to ALL organisation priorities with the same key.
Create a new default status. This will be available for all organisations to use.
Update a default status by id (URL). Changes cascade to ALL organisation statuses with the same key.

item.description: Manage default priorities and statuses that cascade to all organisations

item.name: User Preferences / License Management

query.description: User ID (optional if present in path)

request.description: Get detailed user information by ID. Returns user details (excluding password), role, all organisations, and last 20 login history records.
Get detailed organisation information by ID. Returns organisation details and related data.
Extend the trial period for all users with Trial license in a specific organisation by specified number of days

Manually update a user's license type and renewal date for a specific organisation. Org and user ids are in the URL path; body carries licenseType and renewalDate only. Valid license types: System, Trial, Drift, Glide, Soar

Update general information of an organisation. The organisation id is only in the URL path. Body must contain an `updates` object. Allowed fields: name, address, description, postalCode, surgeryCount, teamCount, currentApp, contact, type, managerId, logo, cqcInspectionDate, status, practiceAnniversaryDate, automationPlaceholders

Update general information of a user. The user id is only in the URL path. Body must contain an `updates` object. Allowed fields: fullName, email, dob, phone, photo, address, status, gender, nextOfKin, nextOfKinContact, requiredCpdHours, roleId

item.description: Manage user licenses and trial periods

item.name: Rota Management

request.description: List all rotas for a specific organisation. Returns rotas with shift counts.
Get a specific rota by ID with all associated shifts and users.
Create a new rota for an organisation. Checks for date conflicts with existing rotas.
Update an existing rota. Only provided fields will be updated.
Soft delete a rota and all its associated shifts.
Publish a rota to make it visible to staff. Sets isPublished to true and records publishedDate.
Unpublish a rota to hide it from staff. Sets isPublished to false.

item.description: Admin CRUD endpoints for managing rotas within organisations

item.name: Rota Shifts Management

request.description: List all shifts for a specific rota with associated staff details.
Get a specific shift by ID with all associated staff and rota details.
Create a new shift for a rota. Checks for conflicts with other shifts. Use forceCreate=true to override cross-org conflict warnings.
Update an existing shift. Only provided fields will be updated. Use forceCreate=true to override cross-org conflict warnings.
Soft delete a rota shift.
Mark a shift as started. Sets startedAt timestamp to current time.
Mark a shift as completed. Sets completedAt timestamp to current time. Shift must have startedAt set first.

item.description: Admin CRUD endpoints for managing rota shifts

item.name: Document Management

request.description: List all document folders in an organisation with document counts.
Get a specific document folder by ID with all its documents.
List all documents in an organisation with optional filters.
Get a specific document by ID.

item.description: Admin endpoints to fetch files and folders in an organisation

Create a new HR document template. Types: Recruitment, Training, Flossly.
Update an existing HR document template.
Delete an HR document template.
Get a specific user's HR document completion status with summary stats. The path id is the user id.

query.description: Filter by type: Recruitment, Training, Flossly (optional)

request.description: List all users' HR document completion status for an organisation with per-user stats.
Update (mark complete/incomplete) a user's HR document row. The path id is the UserHrDocument record id.
